mapper.sql: d.id, d.student_id, d.content, d.create_time, d.reply, d.course_id
mapper.insert: insert into discussion (student_id, content, create_time, reply, course_id) values (#{studentId}, #{content}, #{createTime}, #{reply}, #{courseId})
mapper.select: select , s.name as studentName, s.avatar as studentAvatar, c.name as courseName from discussion d left join student s on d.student_id = s.id left join course c on d.course_id = c.id where d.id = #{id}

select , s.name as studentName, s.avatar as studentAvatar, c.name as courseName from discussion d left join student s on d.student_id = s.id left join course c on d.course_id = c.id
and d.id = #{id} and d.student_id = #{studentId} and d.course_id = #{courseId} and d.content like concat('%', #{content}, '%')
order by d.create_time desc

select , s.name as studentName, s.avatar as studentAvatar, c.name as courseName from discussion d left join student s on d.student_id = s.id left join course c on d.course_id = c.id where d.course_id = #{courseId} order by d.create_time desc
